viewing_check: Check the $10 serial prefix and number (low AA numbers, AA00/AA01 or a repeater/solid serial add value), that it is the dated 26 Jan 1988 commemorative in its original folder, and the corners and fold condition. The JIM notes are common; check only for the Malaya $10 MA and Oceania shillings being uncirculated.
